The decisive mistake was DataVerification_Expert's pivot at step 6 to requests and BeautifulSoup. Openreview.net loads its content dynamically, so a static request returns no paper elements. The script therefore wrote an empty CSV, which caused the EmptyDataError at step 9. The agent also guessed class names such as 'note' and 'recommendation' without inspecting the page, and it never tried the OpenReview API, which would have returned the data directly.

AGENT: DataVerification_Expert
STEP: 6
